title: Enable fallback remux and rerun oversize Ranma outputs
summary: Stop the active queue, change the live operator config SizeGuardMode from advisory to fallback_remux, add H.264 aliases to the live RemuxSafeVideoCodecs allowlist so fallback remux can pass the codec gate, remove oversized automatic-threshold encoded Ranma outputs so they can be rerun, clear the two restart failure markers through the backend clear route, and restart the queue.
reason: The operator expected automatic size/bitrate-threshold encodes that exceed the configured output growth budget to attempt remux fallback instead of publishing oversized encode outputs.
behavior_before: The active live config used SizeGuardMode=advisory, so Ranma H.264 bitrate-threshold encodes that exceeded the 10 percent compatibility growth budget logged warnings and continued publishing.
behavior_after: The active live config uses SizeGuardMode=fallback_remux and includes H.264 aliases in RemuxSafeVideoCodecs, so automatic size/bitrate-threshold H.264 encodes that exceed the growth budget can attempt and pass the configured remux fallback path. Oversized published/parked Ranma outputs from the stopped run are removed from output state so the queue can rerun them.
